style.styleTitle: Homcom 6ft Flocked Pencil Artificial Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: <p>This season isn t the same without snow. No matter the weather this year and beyond, you can bring it into your home, thanks to this HOMCOM artificial Christmas tree. It s sprayed with artificial snow and comes with no decorations - bringing that wintery feel into your home, with space to dress this piece up exactly how you want it. The steel base keeps this flocked Christmas tree standing steady. The top branch is long and sturdy - space for your angel or star topper.</p><ul><li>Sprayed with faux snow for a beautiful wintery look;</li><li>Tall top branch for your topper;</li><li>Hinged branch design - they fall open into place - just need to be rearranged into the desired place afterwards;</li><li>Undressed design: decorate exactly how you want;</li><li>Steel base for tree to stand steady;</li><li>Colour: Green, White;</li><li>Material: PVC, Steel;</li><li>6 Ft: F105 x 180H cm;</li><li>Tip Count: 5FT: 358. 6FT: 750;</li></ul><p>Note: ;</p><p>Only for indoor use, not for outdoor;</p><p>In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual tips to get the best possible look from the tree, suggest you to take 20-25 minutes to shape the tree.;</p>
